description: This file defines mock implementations for testing, specifically mocking functions related to gateway connection configurations. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to create mock functions for various configuration and network-related utilities, such as resolving configuration paths, selecting IP addresses, and checking URL protocols.

methods.name: loadConfigMock
methods.description: Mock function to simulate loading configuration.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPortMock
methods.description: Mock function for resolving gateway port.

methods.name: resolveStateDirMock
methods.description: Mock function to resolve state directory based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveConfigPathMock
methods.description: Mock function to resolve configuration file path.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv4Mock
methods.description: Mock function to select primary tailnet IPv4 address.

methods.name: pickPrimaryLanIPv4Mock
methods.description: Mock function to select primary LAN IPv4 address.

methods.name: isLoopbackHostMock
methods.description: Mock function to check if a host is a loopback address.

methods.name: isSecureWebSocketUrlMock
methods.description: Mock function to determine if a WebSocket URL is secure.

ctags.name: TestMock
ctags.pattern: /^type TestMock<TArgs extends unknown[] = unknown[], TResult = unknown> = Mock<$/

ctags.name: isLoopbackHostMock
ctags.pattern: /^export const isLoopbackHostMock: TestMock<[string], boolean> = vi.fn((host: string) =>$/

ctags.name: resolveConfigPathMock
ctags.pattern: /^export const resolveConfigPathMock: TestMock<[NodeJS.ProcessEnv, string], string> = vi.fn($/
